story.title: BIG-bench 逻辑推理 · logical_deduction/five_objects
story.text: On a shelf, there are five books: a green book, an orange book, a brown book, a yellow book, and a blue book

constraints.text: The orange book is to the right of the yellow book
The green book is the rightmost
The yellow book is to the right of the blue book
The orange book is the third from the left

question_prompt: 谁排在从左数第 3 位？
options: The green book is the third from the left.
The orange book is the third from the left.
The brown book is the third from the left.
The yellow book is the third from the left.
The blue book is the third from the left.
hints: 把每条线索先翻译成“谁在谁前面/后面”。
把能确定的位置先固定下来，再继续推。
explanation: 来自 BIG-bench logical_deduction 第 27 例，由规则翻译器转换（Apache-2.0），未经人工改写。
